the clean comparators are: scrub top (closed_scrub_ring, torso 8x12), scrub pocket (closed_scrub_pocket_shell, 7x14), open cardigan (open_front_c_shell_anterior_gap, torso 11x16), casual top (closed_casual_top_under_layer, 9x18), exam t-shirt (closed_tshirt_ring, 9x12)
their mid-body reads 0.0-7.4% in d1-d3 while the gown reads 9.8-12.2%
constructionComparison.whatDistinguishesTheGown: The gown is the ONLY kind that sets skirt_top_y, which gates BOTH the #481 skirt loft and the #686 two-round whole-shell subdivision + fold gathers. The skirt (d1-d3) is below the fold wave's fade zone (the #686 trunk gathers fade below the hip ring by design), so the skirt sharpness is geometry the fold never touches — matching the card's table. The exported bodice carries ~300 azimuth columns per ring because the #686 block subdivides ALL edges twice on top of the torso grid (11x16). CAUSE of the SKIRT floor specifically is NOT DETERMINED: candidates are the lofted skirt tube's ring density and the #686 subdivision pass applied to the skirt region even though the gathers fade; none is asserted as fact.
